summary: Core ontology guards and signed trust passed targeted inspection, but Learning Graph promotion was mounted without authentication and accepted caller-supplied actor identity.
inspection_summary: Story, Architecture, Spec, InfoSSOT, Learning, publication trust, rollback evidence, production evidence and VibePro Gate were inspected read-only. Eight targeted suites passed 140 tests on the frozen clean HEAD.
inspection_evidence: server/bootstrap/register-api-routes.js; server/routes/learning.js; server/controllers/learning-controller.js; server/services/learning-service.js; server/services/info-ssot-service.js; server/services/ontology-registry.js; server/services/ontology-release-trust.js; targeted 8 suites / 140 tests
judgment_delta: Potentially passable after writer guards -> block because direct path inspection proved unauthenticated Graph mutation and spoofable actor provenance.

findings.detail: POST /api/learning/memory-candidates/:id/promote-to-graph reached the writer without credentials and passed req.body actor identity through.
Merge, deploy and production readback remain follow-up release evidence.
Graph insert and candidate transition are not one explicit transaction.
